faq.title: Questions About Buying the Platform?
faq.description: Everything you need to know regarding servers, installation, technical support, and updates.

items.q: Do I need to prepare my own server for buyout?
items.a: For Starter and Pro packages, we can host it on Sitepow Store's high-speed cloud infrastructure or deploy onto your private VPS/Cloud if preferred. For Ultimate, we deploy directly to your private AWS/GCP/DigitalOcean cloud with full guidance from our team.

items.q: What does the free installation service cover?
items.a: It covers database provisioning, custom domain setup (.com, .co.th, etc.), SSL security certificates, Stripe/payment gateway connection, and full system verification before launch.

items.q: What is covered under the free 1-year technical support?
items.a: It includes bug fixes, technical troubleshooting, configuration assistance, and staff onboarding advice via LINE Official and fast-response email for 12 months.

items.q: What happens after the 1-year free support expires?
items.a: Your platform continues to run normally for a lifetime with zero interruptions or expiration. If desired, you can opt for an optional yearly maintenance agreement (MA) at special rates or manage it yourself.

items.q: Will I still receive new feature and security updates?
items.a: Yes, you continue to receive security patches, bug fixes, and core compatibility updates to keep your store fast and modern.
